# LOTUS Knowledge Explorer

> Explore the LOTUS linked open data knowledge graph: search natural-product compounds, taxa, and references — all openly queryable via SPARQL on Wikidata.

## Core information

- **Official name**: LOTUS Knowledge Explorer
- **Short name**: LOTUS
- **Purpose**: Interactive exploration of natural-product occurrence data
- **Data domain**: Natural products, compounds, taxonomy, scientific references
- **Access model**: Free, web-based, no authentication required

## Features

- Search by compound name, SMILES, or InChI
- Browse taxonomy and references
- Export CSV and JSON for downstream analysis
- Work in English, French, German, and Italian
- Generate QuickStatements for Wikidata curation

## Data sources

- Wikidata SPARQL: https://query.wikidata.org/
- QLever: https://qlever.cs.uni-freiburg.de/wikidata
- DOI metadata: https://doi.org/
- LOTUS initiative: https://lotusnprod.github.io
